preliminary_validations.note: Initial callback declaration/test variant and no enable-failure case; initial snapshots f37e342002f24fbcaa067208c1982843 / 9edb13bc4b404b2e94d365ef9569ac06 not final evidence.
All 673 tests passed each; native private console subsequently refused hidden-console launcher before any console allocation/host body.

native_initial_failure.reason: CreateNoWindow helper still had an existing hidden console; attached guard correctly rejected it. Five old host cases had passed; x86 native console not started.
native_initial_failure.fix: Diagnostic self-spawns with DETACHED_PROCESS into a fresh own child; never detaches/borrows existing console. Own child process handle retained and timeout stop/exit observed; no arbitrary PID kill.

limits: Only software CTRL_C_EVENT/CTRL_BREAK_EVENT to newly created own private console; no user console broadcast, keyboard injection, Hook installation, capture worker or real user config.

Console diagnostic stdin stop flag is always false; actual console handler drives run_with_console to Cooperative/child0; fixture epochs are synthetic, not CaptureSession poll or global recovery proof.

ConsoleControl claims once; NULL/FALSE explicitly enables caller Ctrl+C, close removes its own handler and does not restore an unknown previous ignore attribute. No Attach/Alloc/Free/table mutation while production owner lives.
Close/logoff/shutdown return FALSE and have no cooperative recovery guarantee; real physical keys/Terminal/RDP/window-close/normal capture and trusted release remain unverified.

Private diagnostic failures before body use bounded Drop cleanup; they are not a claim of independent complete cleanup reporting for all failed factories. Successful probes separately report generation/unregister/release plus body resource reports and actual NotFound.
If detached diagnostic timeout stop cannot observe own child exit within its bounded fallback, helper reports failure, not cleanup success.
Prior x86 native process and MSVC-overlap anomalies remain unknown; these checks do not prove fixes.
Detailed child diagnostics/hot config/GUI/trusted packaging, Linux bootstrap/consumer readiness, D05, Rust driver/companion audit and original scope continue.
